(()=>{const t0=performance.now();const ts=document.querySelectorAll('#gxStage text');const rs=[];for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++)rs.push(ts[i].getBoundingClientRect());const N=rs.length;let c=0;for(let p=0;p<N;p++){const a=rs[p];for(let q=p+1;q<N;q++){const b=rs[q];const ox=Math.min(a.right,b.right)-Math.max(a.left,b.left);const oy=Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)-Math.max(a.top,b.top);if(ox>1&&oy>1){const ar=ox*oy;if(ar/Math.min(a.width*a.height,b.width*b.height)>0.28)c++;}}}return {n:N,pairs:+(N*(N-1)/2),hits:c,ms:+(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(1)}})()
